📝Visit report
›
Inspection visit was attended on 22 August 2026 at the vendor facility. This report covers the inspection activities performed by the GQS inspector on behalf of Hancock Energy for the Belisama Gas Project.

Inspector performed 100% final dimensional and visual inspection of the equipment as per the approved Inspection and Test Plan (ITP-BEL-2026-01). All results were found to be acceptable.

• Visual inspection performed — no surface defects, burrs, cracks or pitting found.
• Dimensional check against DWG-BEL-0041 Rev A — all dimensions within tolerance.
• Material traceability verified. IRN issued with acceptable result.

No non-conformances raised. Further visit not required.
